title: Hair Care Package Deal

title: Magic Hair Dye Color Shampoo
subtitle: Colour refresh at home
description:
Refresh your hair colour at home. Magic Hair Dye Color Shampoo colours while you wash, with conditioning ingredients that leave hair soft and shiny.

Choose your shade and follow the instructions that come with your bottle. Results depend on your starting colour, how much grey you have and any previous colouring or treatments, and lighter shades may show little change on dark hair.

Before every use, do the allergy (patch) test in the product instructions, even if you have used hair dye before. Wear gloves, keep it away from your eyes, eyebrows and eyelashes, and do not use it on an irritated or broken scalp.
excerpt: Refresh your hair colour at home. Magic Hair Dye Color Shampoo colours while you wash, with conditioning ingredients that leave hair soft and shiny.
